items.title: J. Leo Rayhill interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 23, 2007
items.q: My favorite story is the great James raid when Duke Ellington stole Harry’s three best men.

ctx.x: Harry was a great talent. My favorite story is the great James raid when Duke Ellington stole Harry’s three best men. And they were interviewing them for Down Beat, they were interviewing Harry and said, “You must hate Duke Ellington after what he did to your band.” “No,” he says, “he had good talent for finding good people — he took my three best.”
You have to give him credit for that. You know locally Jack Palmer played with Harry for quite a long time.
